# GitHub Actions workflows

- `ci.yml` — Phase 0 CI plus the firmware pipeline. Every job below runs; none is gated off.

| Job | Status | What it checks |
|-----|--------|----------------|
| `markdown-lint` | advisory (`continue-on-error`) | `markdownlint-cli2` over every `*.md` outside `scratch/` and `docs/reference-projects/clones/`. Advisory on purpose: vendor-quoted tables and ASCII diagrams trip style rules that are not worth a red build. |
| `link-check` | **blocking** | `lychee --offline --include-fragments` over every Markdown file: every relative link and heading anchor must resolve. This is the enforcement of the "relative links only, works on GitHub and offline" rule in [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md). External URLs are deliberately not checked per push — bibliography links are re-verified during acquisition passes and ledgered in `docs/bibliography/acquisition-status.md`. If a link to a *directory* is ever reported broken, tune lychee's directory handling (`--fallback-extensions`, `index.md`) rather than rewriting the link to a file. |
| `guard-hooks` | **blocking** | The repo-local `pre-commit` hooks, run `--all-files` one id at a time (`pre-commit run` takes a single hook id; passing several exits 2 and tests nothing): `pdf-redistributable`, `spdx-header`, `no-usb-pins`, `pins-h-usb-reserved-only`, `sdkconfig-invariants`, `partitions-arithmetic`, `presets-rules`, `markers-baseline`, and since 2026-08-21 (roadmap H0) `golden-regen` and `host-boundary` (rows below). Then an independent scan of every `.c/.h/.cpp/.hpp` under `firmware/` for `GPIO_NUM_(19\|20)` / `GPIO(19\|20)` with string literals blanked and comment lines dropped — the same rules as the hook — so [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md) Never-rule 1 holds even if the hook definition is edited away. The scan **fails closed**: an empty file list or any non-{0,1} grep / non-0 sed exit is a tooling error (exit 2), never "clean". Added 2026-08-21; the upstream style hooks (clang-format, shellcheck, codespell, kconfig) stay the developer's business. |
| `python-scripts` | **blocking** | `python -m compileall -q python-scripts` (the stated reason `doc_ocr` may take no runtime dependencies; runs before any `uv sync` so it never descends into a `.venv`), then `pytest` in `python-scripts/doc_ocr/` (captured-output fixtures, no poppler needed), then — with `uv==0.11.32`, the version on the development machine, `~/.cache/uv` cached on the three `uv.lock` hashes — for each of `python-scripts/synth_signals/` and `python-scripts/golden_compare/`: `uv lock --check` (the lock still matches `pyproject.toml`; `--frozen` alone would not notice), `uv sync --frozen --extra test`, `uv run pytest -q`; then the Tier-0 reproducibility test: `synth_signals generate` writes the WAVs, the **tracked** `datasets/tier0-synthetic/manifest.yaml` is put back (`generate` rewrites it, which would make the check compare the runner with itself), and `synth_signals check` re-renders every signal in memory on the runner's libm and fails on any sha256 that differs from the manifest; then `check_markers.py --self-test` plus the baseline run (an unresolved-value marker without an owner fails) and `check_presets.py --verbose` (preset schema + loader rules V0–V10). `host/` is GPL-licensed and has its own job. |
| `host` | **blocking** | The GPL-3.0-or-later half of the licence boundary ([ADR 0004](../../docs/adr/0004-split-licensing.md)) in its own environment: `fetch-depth: 0` — rule G1 of `verify` resolves `tolerances.revision` with `git cat-file`, and `spectral_host.env` records `HEAD`, `uv==0.11.32`, the Tier-0 WAVs regenerated first from their own uv project (gitignored inputs of the `tier0-synthetic` golden set; verify rule I4 hashes them), `uv lock --check --project host` + `uv sync --project host --frozen --extra dev`, `uv run --project host pytest -q host/tests`, `uv run --project host spectral-golden verify` (rules S, I1–I8, N1–N4, G1 over every `host/golden/outputs/*/manifest.yaml`; CI is the environment the pins are compared against, so no `--no-env-check`; a red step is a decision request, never a regeneration — [ADR 0009](../../docs/adr/0009-golden-file-strategy.md) item 4). Then the boundary as four separate failing steps, so the step name says which side leaked: no `SPDX-License-Identifier: …GPL…` in the first 5 lines of any tracked file outside `host/` (prose mentions are not headers; fails closed on an empty listing); `git grep -nE '^(from\|import) spectral_host' -- . ':!host'` empty; `git grep -nE '^(from\|import) (synth_signals\|golden_compare\|check_presets\|doc_ocr)' -- ':(glob)host/**/*.py'` empty; `git grep -n 'sys\.path' -- host/src` empty (`git grep` rc 1 is the only clean outcome; 0 and 2 both fail). Added 2026-08-21 with roadmap H0. |
| `firmware` | **blocking** (all four matrix configs) | Job-level `container:` pinned to `espressif/idf:v6.0.2@sha256:0d8c9773…cb67` (one `env: IDF_IMAGE` to bump, and the same digest repeated in `container.image` because Actions does not expand `env:` there), `idf-build-apps` over the four matrix configs — `default` (plain `sdkconfig.defaults`; there is no `sdkconfig.ci.default` file, and idf-build-apps falls back when no config rule matches) plus `sdkconfig.ci.{release,qemu,analyzer}` — `dependencies.lock` must be unchanged by the build, **build twice and diff sha256** on the release config, `idf.py size` / `size-components`, `esp-idf-sbom create` + `check` (CVE gate; full `--file-tags` licence scan on tags only), artifacts with `.bin/.elf/.map/flasher_args.json/project_description.json`. |

## Local hooks that also run in CI (`guard-hooks`)

Two hooks added 2026-08-21 with roadmap H0, both `repo: local`, `pass_filenames: false`, negative-tested in throwaway repositories before they landed:

| Hook | What it refuses | Where the rule comes from |
|------|-----------------|---------------------------|
| `golden-regen` | A commit whose **staged set** touches both `host/golden/outputs/` (vectors and their manifests) and `docs/validation/golden-files.md` (the only place a tolerance is defined). File-level on purpose: a widened limit is exactly the edit that hides in a prose-table diff. When nothing is staged (`pre-commit run -a`, the CI loop) it checks the `HEAD` commit instead — `git diff-tree --root` — so the CI run asserts something about the tip rather than passing vacuously; a merge commit has no single diff and passes. When `HEAD` is the cut of a shallow clone it exits 2 instead of diffing (git then reports the tip as parentless and `--root` would list the whole tree — a false red on every push), which is why `guard-hooks` checks out with `fetch-depth: 2`. The escape is two commits with two reasons, not `SKIP=`. | [ADR 0009](../../docs/adr/0009-golden-file-strategy.md) item 4, which names this hook as its Phase-1 deliverable. |
| `host-boundary` | (a) a tracked file outside `host/` whose first 5 lines carry a GPL SPDX identifier; (b) `import spectral_host` anywhere outside `host/`; (c) any `.py` under `host/` (src, tests, golden) importing `synth_signals`, `golden_compare`, `check_presets` or `doc_ocr`; (d) `host/src` touching `sys.path` (`host/tests` may read it — `test_env.py` proves `python-scripts/` is not on it). Runs on every commit (four `git grep`s). The `host` job repeats the same four greps as named steps, the way the GPIO19/20 scan repeats `no-usb-pins`. | [ADR 0004](../../docs/adr/0004-split-licensing.md): the licence boundary is the directory; the halves exchange files on disk only. |

## The firmware job was enabled in roadmap E1 *(historical)*

It shipped behind `if: false` and was flipped on **2026-08-20** (commit `6160532`, "ci: enable the firmware job") once the four preconditions below were met. They are kept as the checklist for any future re-gating or IDF-version move, not as an open item:

1. `firmware/twatch-s3/dependencies.lock` is committed (generated by `idf.py set-target esp32s3 && idf.py build` on the pinned v6.0.2 tree with no `IDF_COMPONENT_LOCAL_STORAGE_URL` mirror in the environment).
2. The container digest in `env: IDF_IMAGE` **and** in the job's `container.image` has been re-derived (`docker buildx imagetools inspect espressif/idf:v6.0.2 --format '{{println .Manifest.Digest}}'`) and `docs/devenv/env.lock.md` records the same digest. GitHub Actions does not expand `env:` inside `container.image`, which is why the digest appears twice; keep them identical.
3. `sdkconfig.ci.release`, `sdkconfig.ci.qemu` and `sdkconfig.ci.analyzer` exist next to `sdkconfig.defaults`.
4. The 30-minute gate build described in [ADR 0001](../../docs/adr/0001-toolchain-esp-idf-v6-pinned-environment.md) passed locally.

First fully green run: workflow run **#18** on `4468334` (2026-08-21) — all four firmware configs plus the docs, link and Python jobs. The `guard-hooks` job and the marker/preset steps had their **first remote run on `7e8a1cc`** (the Phase-0 merge, run [32541479272](https://github.com/alexandergmzx/superspectral/actions/runs/32541479272), 2026-08-21): all eight jobs green, including the eight-hook loop and the fail-closed GPIO19/20 scan. `markdown-lint` reported MD013/MD060 on this file — advisory, non-blocking, left as is. **First remote run of the `host` job on `61a2358`** (the H0 merge, run [32549170456](https://github.com/alexandergmzx/superspectral/actions/runs/32549170456), 2026-08-22): nine jobs green; the remote parselmouth matched the golden manifest's pins exactly (`spectral-golden verify: ok (14 rules)`) and the Tier-0 corpus reproduced byte-for-byte on the runner's libm (`synth_signals check` 21/21).

If a future gate fails and the project falls back to v5.5.5, change the tag, the digest and `.envrc` together, and record it in ADR 0001.

## Conventions

- Actions: **every** third-party action is pinned to a full commit SHA, with the release tag it was resolved from in a trailing comment. A major tag (`@v7`) is repointable, so it is not a pin. To bump, re-resolve the new tag — `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/tags/<tag> --jq .object.sha`, dereferencing once more through `repos/.../git/tags/<sha>` when `.object.type` is `tag` — and change the SHA and the comment together. The IDF image is likewise pinned by **digest**, never by tag alone (`latest` and `release-v6.0` are rebuilt continuously).
- Tool versions inside the container are pinned exactly (`idf-build-apps==3.0.2`, `esp-idf-sbom==1.3.1`, `pytest-embedded==2.8.1` when the QEMU job lands) and mirrored in `docs/devenv/env.lock.md`.
- The three Python environments are three `uv` projects with three committed locks (`host/uv.lock`, `python-scripts/synth_signals/uv.lock`, `python-scripts/golden_compare/uv.lock`) and never share a `.venv` — see [`docs/devenv/setup.md`](../../docs/devenv/setup.md) §10. CI installs `uv==0.11.32`, the version on the development machine, and checks each lock with `uv lock --check` before `uv sync --frozen`; bump the pin here, on the machine and in `setup.md` together.
- Deferred jobs are listed as a comment at the end of `ci.yml` with the file that tracks each, in the order they are worth adding: host-tests → qemu-tests → size-diff → lvgl-native → static-analysis → env-lock-diff → hil. `host-tests` (the Apache-2.0 C lane for `spectral_core`) is not the `host` job above and stays deferred until `spectral_core` has sources. HIL never runs on fork PRs and always flashes an OTA slot, never `ota_0`.
- `permissions: contents: read` at the top; a job that needs more (the future size-diff PR comment) declares it locally.
